# Vendored: Parts Export v1

Copied unchanged from [ricardomgoncalves/cabinet-planner](https://github.com/ricardomgoncalves/cabinet-planner),
directory `docs/parts-export/`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source commit | `f2da2ceb21ff4c715a9925313ee9dc2d4b47de4a` (`f2da2ce`, 2026-11-23) |
| Files | `parts-export.v1.schema.json` (the contract), `parts-export.v1.guide.md` (reference only) |

Do not edit these files. To update, copy both again from a newer cabinet-planner commit and
change the commit above. A newer **minor** version is validated against its own schema file
(the schema is strict: `additionalProperties: false`), so vendor it next to this one rather
than over it once exports of that minor need to load.

Relative links in the guide point into cabinet-planner's repository and do not resolve here.
